In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the semantic Web and semantic grid are a new trend of the development of information technology,and the Tx-Grid is a good example to demonstrate the application and value of semantic Web and semantic Grid.
the semantic grid technology is a new way to solve the data resource integration problem,and the mechanism proposed in the paper has a good effect on integrating heterogeneous data resources.
the semantic grid technology is the future direction of the grid development and the key to realize e-governance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the semantic grid is a promising way to solve the problem of data resources integration,and the Tx-Grid prototype can be applied in other fields.
the semantic grid theory provides a good method for the data resources integration,and the ontology-based mechanism for integrating the data resources is effective and feasible.
the semantic grid theory provides a new method to solve the problem of information island,and Tx-Grid is a successful application of the semantic grid theory in e-government.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ontology can be used as the bridge to integrate heterogeneous distributed resources,and that the semantic grid theory is a feasible method to integrate the distributed resources.
ontology can be used to describe the semantic information of the database,which makes the data resources more easily to be understood and shared.
ontology can help the integration of data resources and provide an efficient way to access and share the data resources in a semantic grid environment.
